examples.label: Run the exploit (ld.so.preload overwrite -> setuid root)

notes: PoC builds /tmp/libhax.so (chown/chmod /tmp/rootshell, unlink ld.so.preload) and /tmp/rootshell.c (setuid(0);execvp(/bin/sh)), writes \n/tmp/libhax.so into /etc/ld.so.preload via setuid screen.

recommended.note: Match the version against known-vuln services.

name: Vulnerable Service - GNU screen 4.5.0 root
description: setuid GNU screen 4.5.0 lets a user overwrite /etc/ld.so.preload to load an attacker library as root. The screenroot.sh PoC compiles a libhax.so + rootshell and triggers it.

defense.why_it_works: GNU Screen version 4.5.0 has a SUID root binary with a setuid-screen vulnerability. By exploiting ld.so.preload overwriting via Screen's log file creation, an attacker can cause the SUID screen binary to load a malicious shared library (/tmp/libhax.so) as root, which then creates a SUID root shell binary (/tmp/rootshell).
defense.prerequisites: GNU Screen 4.5.0 installed with SUID bit. Ability to write to /etc/ (via ld.so.preload path). gcc available (or pre-compiled exploit).
defense.impact: Local root privilege escalation via the SUID screen vulnerability. Creates a SUID root shell at /tmp/rootshell.
defense.detection: Unusual screen execution with -D -m -L flags logging to /etc/ld.so.preload. Unexpected .so file loaded by screen process. /tmp/rootshell with SUID bit appearing. Auditd: /etc/ld.so.preload modification by non-root.
defense.artifacts: Auditd: write to /etc/ld.so.preload by screen (SUID process) | File: /tmp/libhax.so and /tmp/rootshell created | SUID shell at /tmp/rootshell
defense.splunk_spl:
index=linux sourcetype="linux:auditd" name="/etc/ld.so.preload" (a1="*O_WRONLY*" OR a1="*O_CREAT*")
| where auid!=0
| table _time, host, auid, exe

index=linux sourcetype="linux:auditd" (name="/tmp/rootshell" OR name="/tmp/libhax.so")
| table _time, host, exe, name
defense.elastic_kql: event.category:file AND file.path:/etc/ld.so.preload AND NOT user.name:root
defense.sentinel_kql:
Syslog
| where SyslogMessage has_any ("ld.so.preload","/tmp/rootshell","/tmp/libhax.so","screen -D -m -L")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SyslogMessage
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
// CVE-2017-5618 screen SUID: write to /etc/ld.so.preload then a SUID /tmp/rootshell
defense.prevention: Update GNU Screen to a patched version (4.5.1+). Remove SUID bit from screen if multi-user screen sharing is not required. Audit SUID binaries for vulnerable versions.
defense.misconfiguration: GNU Screen 4.5.0 installed with SUID root bit. This version has a known critical vulnerability enabling local root compromise.
defense.vulnerable_config:
# Vulnerable screen
screen -v
# Screen version 4.05.00  <- vulnerable
ls -la /usr/bin/screen
# -rwsr-sr-x 1 root utmp ... /usr/bin/screen
defense.secure_config:
# Update screen
apt install --only-upgrade screen

# If sharing not needed, remove SUID
chmod u-s /usr/bin/screen

# Verify version
screen -v  # should be > 4.5.0

response_steps: Correlate alert with source host, user account, and timestamp
Review Linux Audit (auditd), Windows Security Event Log for surrounding context (5 min before/after)
Verify whether the activity matches known administrative baselines or change windows
If confirmed malicious, isolate the host and escalate to incident response

explain:
Exploits setuid GNU screen 4.5.0 to load an attacker library as root:
  screen -v                print the version to confirm 4.05.00 / v4.5.0
The bug lets you overwrite /etc/ld.so.preload so a library of yours loads with root privilege; the screenroot.sh PoC compiles libhax.so + a rootshell and triggers it, dropping /tmp/rootshell.
